content.question: Match the various metrics for unsupervised learning problems with their intuitive definitions

answer.Support: How popular an itemset is, i.e. the frequency of the itemset within the dataset
answer.Confidence: Measures the conditional probability of seeing the consequent item given the antecedent
answer.Lift: Assesses the increase of the probability of the consequent when the antecedent is present
answer.Silhouette Score: How similar instances are to each other within their clusters and how different they are across clusters
answer.Adjusted Rand Index: Evaluates expected and predicted clusters adjusting for randomness
